texts.facts: 1. The case of the prosecution in brief is that on 07.04.2013 at about 02:00 pm at H. No.C-69, Gali No.05, Shiv Ram Park, Nihal Vihar, New Delhi within the jurisdiction of PS Nihal Vihar, both the accused persons knowingly or negligently omitted to take such order with the building of the above said address while pulling it down as is sufficient to guard against any probable danger to human life from fall of that building. Further, due to their aforesaid negligence and omission of both the accused persons, both the accused persons caused death of one Gautam not amounting to culpable homicide and thus thereby both the accused persons committed an offence punishable under State vs Denesh Kumar on 23 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167055762/ 1 Section 288/304A IPC within the cognizance of this Court. After completion of necessary formalities, charge sheet was filed in this Court. Cognizance was taken. The accused persons were summoned. Charge was framed against the accused persons, to which they pleaded not guilty and claimed trial. 2. PROSECUTION EVIDENCE In order to substantiate its case, prosecution has examined 10 witnesses. The testimony of all the witnesses are reproduced hereunder for ready reference and the relevancy and admissibility of said testimony will be dealt with at the later part of the judgment : 3. Statement of PW1 Sh. Manoj Kumar Singh : "On 07.04.2013 at about 4.00 pm, I received information that my brother namely Gautam Kumar was lying at his place from where I alongwith his wife had taken him to Safdarjung Hospital. He was declared dead on 08.04.2013. I had identified his dead body vide Identification Memo Ex.PW-1/A bearing my signature at point 'A'. I received his dead body. I got to know that my brother had fell down from the roof of owner namely Swarn Lal while he was working there." Thereafter, he was duly cross- Digitally signed by KOMAL KOMAL Date: GARG GARG 2026.01.23 18:20:11 State Vs. Denesh Kumar and anr. FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar +0530 Page No. 2 of 13 examined by the Ld. Counsels for both the accused . 4. Statement of PW2 Smt. Gayatri : "I do not remember the date, month and year of the incident. I am illiterate. On the of incident at about 12.50 pm, I went to the place where my husband was working as a labourer, in order to ask him about his lunch. He was working in Shiv Ram Park, Gali No.5. My husband namely Gautam replied that he would come to home for the lunch and accordingly I came back to my home. After half an hour, one of the labourer came at my home and told me that my husband had fallen down from the house. Thereafter, I along-with that labourer went to the house where my husband was working and I found him lying near the school which is 5-10 footsteps away from that house where my husband was working. Thereafter, I brought my husband to my place and he vomited. I had taken my husband to the hospital where he was declared dead. I do not know anything else about this case." Thereafter, she was then cross-examined by the Ld. APP for the State as she was not disclosing the complete facts. Thereafter, she was cross- examined by the Ld. counsels for both the accused. 5. Statement of PW3 Sh. Kundan Singh : State vs Denesh Kumar on 23 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167055762/ 2 "On 09.04.2013, I along with Sh. Manoj and other relatives of the deceased namely Gautam went to mortuary of Safdarjung hospital, New Delhi and identified the dead body of my cousin brother namely Gautam who had expired in the incident. After post-mortem examination, I had identified the dead body of deceased Gautam for cremation vide identification memo which is Ex. PW-3/A bearing my signature at point A." Thereafter, he was duly cross-examined by ld. Counsels for both the accused. 6. Statement of PW4 Sh. Santosh : "I am residing at the aforesaid address along with my family members. At the Digitally signed by KOMAL KOMAL GARG GARG Date: 2026.01.23 State Vs. Denesh Kumar and anr. FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar 18:20:17 Page No. 3 of 13 +0530 time of incident, I was working a daily wages labour. For the same purpose, I used to sit on a Chowk of Adhayapak Nagar, Labour Chowk, Nangloi, Delhi. On 07.04.2013, I along with deceased Gautam and other persons were sitting on the said Adhayapak Nagar Chowk. On that day, one Thekedar/Mistri namely Dinesh came to the said Chowk and asked us to come towards Shiv Ram Park as there was a contract for breaking a house. On his asking, I along with the deceased Gautam went with him as a labourer on the tune of Rs. 300/- each. On the direction of Dinesh, who was Mistri/Thekedar and owner of the house, we started breaking the said house but while we were doing the same, we were not provided the safety helmet which were required for our safety to save us from any unseen incident. Thereafter, when we were breaking the said house, all of sudden, the deceased Gautam got fallen down from the said building upon the malva (pathar, rori & bricks etc.) which were lying there while were breaking the said building. Thereafter, I saw the deceased Gautam and blood was oozing from his body. I requested Thekedar namely Dinesh and owner of the house to take the deceased to hospital and I also requested them to make the call on 100 number but they did not do the same and they took the deceased to his house, where he was residing on the rented accommodation and from there, he was taken to hospital. If we provided with the safety helmets, the alleged incident did not take place. At the present, I am unable to recollect as to whether police official had enquired about the incident from me or not. Both the accused persons are present in the court today [Correctly identified by the witness] [At this stage, 5 photographs of the spot of incident is shown to witness and he correctly identifies the same as a spot from where the deceased got falling down after getting slipped, which is Ex. P-1 (Colly)" Thereafter, he was duly cross-examined by the Ld. Counsels for both the accused. 7. PW5 ASI Badlu Ram was formal witness. Digitally signed by KOMAL KOMAL GARG GARG 2026.01.23 18:20:24 +0530 FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar Page No. 4 of 13 8. Statement of PW6 Sh. Ram Lal : "The incident took place 4 year ago. The work of demolition of house was going on daily basis at the house situated at Shiv Ram Park. On the day of incident, mistri Dinesh had brought me at the spot for the work of demolition and before this, accused Dinesh had also brought one other labour at the spot for the same work. In between, at about 3.00 to 4.00 p.m., that labour fell down on malba and he sustained the injury in his forehead from the broken piece of brick. Thereafter, I along with Dinesh & other labour took the injured labour in the clinic near the spot. Thereafter, the injured labour was sent to his home after giving the initial medical treatment. Thereafter, I also went to my house. On the next day, police came at the spot and police official interrogated me and clicked the photographs myself and other labours and took the mobile phone number of myself and other labours. The accused Denesh is present in the court today [present in the Court today and correctly identified by the witness]." He was then cross- examined by the Ld. APP for the State as he was resiling from his earlier statement. Thereafter, he was duly cross-examined by the Ld. Counsels for both the accused. 9. Statement of PW7 Dr. Kamran Faisal : "I am working as Medical Officer in the aforesaid hospital since 2009. Dr. Surya Kumar Singh, Jr. Resident has left the services of the hospital and present whereabouts of Dr. Surya Kumar Singh are not known to hospital. I have been deputed by CMO/MRO, MRD Office to depose in place of Dr. Surya Kumar Singh as I have seen Dr. Surya Kumar Singh signing and writing on number of occasion during course of my official duty. Therefore, I am in position to identify the signatures and hand-writing of Dr. Surya Kumar Singh. At this stage, MLC No. 65321/13 of Patient Mr. Gautam is shown to the witness and witness identifies hand-writing from portion A to A1 of Dr. Surya Kumar Singh and his Signature at point B on the said MLC which is Ex. Digita signed KOMAL KOMAL GARG GARG Date: 2026.0 State Vs. Denesh Kumar and anr. FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar 18:20: PW-7/A.] As per the MLC, at the time of medical examination, patient was unconscious, his pupils mid dilated, ICU call was given, Patient was intubated and he was shifted to ward B." Thereafter, he was duly cross-examined by the ld. Counsels State vs Denesh Kumar on 23 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167055762/ 4 for both the accused. 10. Statement of PW8 Dr. Gaurav Vinod Jain : "I am working as Professor in the aforesaid hospital since 2012. Dr. Snehil Tripathi & Dr. Chetan Kumar R have left the services of the hospital and present whereabouts of Dr. Dr. Snehil Tripathi & Dr. Chetan Kumar R are not known to hospital. I have been deputed by HOD Department of Forensic Medicine, Safdarjung Hospital to depose in place of Dr. Snehil Tripathi & Dr. Chetan Kumar R as I have seen Dr. Snehil Tripathi & Dr. Chetan Kumar R signing on number of occasion during course of my official duty. Therefore, I am in position to identify the signatures of Dr. Dr. Snehil Tripathi & Dr. Chetan Kumar R. [At this stage, PM report No. 489/13 of deceased Mr. Gautam is shown to the witness and witness identifies the signature of Dr. Snehil Tripathi at point A and B and Signature of Dr. Chetan Kumar R at point C on the said PM report which is Ex. PW-8/A.] As per the PM report, death is due to the shock as a result of cranio- cerebral damage due to blunt force impact. All injuries are ante- mortem in nature." 11. Statement of PW9 Rtd. SI Ajaib Singh : "ON 07.04.2013 I was posted at PS Nihal Vihar as ASI. On that day, I was present at the PS I received DD No. 41 A regarding admission of injured at Safdurgunj Hospital. I along with Ct. Vinod went to Safdurgunj Hospital, Delhi. I met with the concerned Dr. at the emergancy ward of the hospital and collected MLC of injured Gautam which is already Ex. PW-7/A and the concerned Dr. opined that injured is unfit for statement. Digitally signed by KOMAL KOMAL Date: GARG GARG 2026.01.23 State Vs. Denesh Kumar and anr. FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar 18:20:36 Wife of injured Gautam namely Gyatri Devi met me at the hospital. She gave me her statement which is Ex. PW-9/A bearing my attestation at point A. I along with Ct. came back at the spot i.e. Shiv Ram Park C-69 Nihal Vihar Delhi. I enquired the neighbourhood person as to incident. Thereafter, I prepared the rukka on the statement of Gyatri which is Ex. PW-9/B bearing my signature at point A. I handed over the same to Ct. Vinod who took the same and came back at the spot. Meanwhile, I also enquired the persons nearby the spot. Ct. Vinod handed over the copy of FIR and Rukka to me and we reached to the house of injured Gautam. Where I met with the wife of injured Gyatri and elder brother of injured namely Manoj and they apprised me that the injured Gautam was expired during treatment. Thereafter, I came back at the PS and inform the SHO regarding the incident. Thereafter, the then SHO directed me to proceed with investigation. During investigation I got conducted post mortem of deceased vide form No. 25.35(1)(B) which is Ex. PW-9/C bearing my signature at point A and request for post mortem is Ex. PW-9/D bearing State vs Denesh Kumar on 23 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167055762/ 5 my signature at point A. I got identified the dead body of deceased Gautam and recorded the statement of witnesses which is already Ex. PW-1/A and Ex. PW-3/A bearing my signature at point B respectively. The dead body was handed over to relative of deceased after post mortem. I prepared site plan at the instance of Gyatri which is Ex. PW-9/E bearing my signature at point A bearing RTI of Gyatri at point B. During investigation, I arrested accused persons vide arrest memo already Ex. PW-2/A and Ex. PW-2/B bearing my signature at point B. Accused persons were personally searched vide memo Ex. PW-2/C and Ex. PW-2/D bearing my signature at point B. Both accused persons were arrested on the separate dates, however, I do not remember the date of their arrest. Both accused persons were released on police bail as the offences are bailable one. On completion of investigation I filed the challan before the court. Accused present in the court today and correctly identified by the witness." Thereafter, he was then cross-examined by the Ld. APP for the State as he was not disclosing the complete facts. Thereafter, he was cross-examined by the Ld. counsels for Digitally signed by KOMAL KOMAL Date: GARG GARG 2026.01.23 18:20:42 State Vs. Denesh Kumar and anr. FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar +0530 Page No. 7 of 13 both the accused. 12. Statement of PW10 HC Vinod : "On 07.04.2013 I was posted at PS Nihal Vihar. On that day I joined with the IO Ajaib Singh. We reached at the Safdurgunj Hospital where I collected the MLC of Injured and also met with the wife of injured and recorded her statement that her husband got fallen from the building where he was working. After that we reached at the spot i.e. Shiv Ram Park and IO prepared site plan of the spot. IO also seized chisel and hammer from the spot vide seizure memo already Ex. PW-9/G beraring my signature at point B. IO handed over rukka to me accordingly I went to PS and got registered FIR. I returned back to the spot. The wife of injured came at the spot and who told us that injured got expired at the hospital. IO searched the witnesses of the present matter met with them and recorded their statement. I can identify the case property, if shown to me." Thereafter, he was then cross-examined by the Ld. APP for the State. Thereafter, he was cross-examined by the Ld. counsels for both the accused. 13. Thereafter, separate statements of accused persons u/s 313 of Cr.P.C. were recorded, wherein all the incriminating facts were put to the accused persons. Accused Sarvan Lal submitted that he has been falsely implicated as he has already given the contract to the contractor for the construction purposes and his version was not taken into view by the police officials. The deceased Gautam has been intoxicated with Bhaang on the date of incident. Further, accused Dinesh Kumar submitted that police officials have falsely implicated him. He himself is another labourer and not the contractor. The witnesses were planted by the police and therefore, they did not depose against him. Accused persons did not lead any defence evidence. Accordingly, DE of the Digitally accused persons State vs Denesh Kumar on 23 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167055762/ 6 has been closed. As per testimonies of Doctor ie PW7 & PW8 at the time of the MLC, patient was unconscious and his pupils mid dilated and he was shifted to ward B. Thereafter, PW10 HC Vinod was State vs Denesh Kumar on 23 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167055762/ 8 examined who accompanied IO ie PW9. 20.
texts.arguments: The provisions of section 288 IPC is reproduced below :- IPC Section 288 deals with "Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down or repairing buildings," making it a punishable offense for anyone who, while demolishing or fixing a structure, fails to take adequate precautions to prevent danger to human life from its collapse, punishable by up to six months jail, a fine of 1000, or both, and is a bailable, non-cognizable offense triable by any Magistrate The provisions of section 304A IPC is reproduced below :- Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both. 16. The terminology of criminal negligence has been discussed by Honble Supreme Court in the judgment titled as 'S. N. Hussain vs. State of Andra Pradesh' AIR 1972 SC 685 as under;- "Criminal negligence on the other hand, is the cross and culpable neglect or failure to exercise that reasonable and proper care and precaution to guard against injury either to the public generally or to an individual in particular, which, having regard all the circumstance out of which the charge has arisen it was the imperative duty of the accused person to have adopted..... Culpable negligence lies in the failure to exercise reasonable and proper care and the extent of its reasonableness would always depend upon the circumstances of each case". State Vs. Denesh Kumar and anr. FIR No. 107/2013, PS Nihal Vihar +0530 Page No. 11 of 13 sufficient to prove the spot of incident and consequently, the rash or negligent act on the part of the accused persons. 22. It is a settled position of law that whenever there are two views possible, the view which favors the innocence of the accused is to be accepted by the court. The judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Mahadeo Hari Lokre vs. State of Maharastra AIR 1972 SC 221 has been relied upon 23. It is an established principle of criminal law if prosecution fails to prove its case beyond a reasonable doubt, the accused is entitle to acquittal and Court does not need to consider the defense's case. The burden of proof is solely on the prosecution to establish the guilt of the accused, and if they failed to meet this standard, the accused defense becomes irrelevant.
